cause.line: Vandagos (tank) died to Blighted Sever at 8:54, his fourth in a row. The other tank, Tyralien, had been dead since 7:39. The raid fell apart in the next 25 s.
proof: Blighted Sever hit Vandagos at 7:13.1, 7:46.5, 8:23.1 and 8:54.3 (1.88M, dead)
Tyralien died at 7:38.9 to Death's Embrace, feared by a Wail of Terror that got off at 7:33.7 (15 feared), and was not brought back
6 more died in the 10 s after 8:54.3 (two to the boss's melee)
